name: Subtask rollup
description: Closes the loop on decomposed work: when the last open subtask of a parent task is done or cancelled, the parent moves to In review with a rollup comment — so the human gate (review-gate workflow, for agent-assigned parents) signs off on the whole, not just the parts. Upward cascades are bounded by construction: each level parks at In review and needs a human approval before it can close and trigger the next level.

config.description: Root tasks have no parent to roll up into.

steps.name: All siblings closed and parent still open?

config.expression: steps.progress.output.data.allClosed == true && steps.progress.output.data.parentArchived == false && steps.progress.output.data.parentStatus != 'done' && steps.progress.output.data.parentStatus != 'cancelled' && steps.progress.output.data.parentStatus != 'in_review'
config.description: Only the run that closes the LAST subtask advances the parent; a parent already at In review (or closed) is left alone.

parameters.body: [automated] 📦 All {{steps.progress.output.data.total}} subtasks are closed — moving this task to In review for sign-off.

steps.name: Move the parent to In review
